name: Nishida Kitaro
shortBio: Founding philosopher of the Kyoto School who synthesized Mahayana Buddhist metaphysics with Western phenomenology, articulating the 'Logic of Basho' (Place) and the ontology of Absolute Nothingness (mu).
centralQuestion: What is the primordial horizon of 'pure experience' prior to the bifurcation of subject and object, and how is it grounded in Absolute Nothingness?

keyWorks.title: An Inquiry into the Good (Zen no Kenkyū)
keyWorks.description: Foundational text establishing 'pure experience' prior to subject-object distinction as the source of reality, knowledge, and moral goodness.

keyWorks.title: From the Acting to the Seeing (Hataraku mono kara miru mono e)
keyWorks.description: Key formulation of the 'Logic of Basho' (Place), theorizing reality from the ultimate place of Absolute Nothingness.
